kpis.description_en: FY24 Ingrezza (valbenazine, VMAT2 inhibitor) sales. Tardive dyskinesia + Huntington's chorea indications. >3Bn$ peak anticipated.

kpis.description_fr: Crinecerfont (CRF1 antagonist, hyperplasie congénitale surrénales) Phase 3 réussie 2024. FDA approval prévue 2025 (PDUFA). Cible $1-2Md ventes pic.
kpis.description_en: Crinecerfont (CRF1 antagonist, congenital adrenal hyperplasia) Phase 3 success 2024. FDA approval expected 2025 (PDUFA). $1-2Bn peak sales target.

kpis.description_fr: R&D FY24. Investissement pipeline neuro/endocrino broad. Programmes Phase 3 multiples.
kpis.description_en: FY24 R&D. Broad neuro/endocrino pipeline investment. Multiple Phase 3 programs.

kpis.description_fr: Patients actifs Ingrezza FY24. TAM TD estimé 600K+ US, pénétration <5%. Long runway adoption.
kpis.description_en: FY24 active patients Ingrezza. Estimated TD TAM 600K+ US, <5% penetration. Long adoption runway.

kpis_story.description_fr: Crinecerfont = première nouvelle option thérapeutique CAH classique adultes/peds en 70 ans. FDA PDUFA décembre 2025. Cible $1-2Md pic, premier blockbuster non-Ingrezza pour NBIX.
kpis_story.description_en: Crinecerfont = first new classic CAH therapeutic option for adults/peds in 70 years. FDA PDUFA December 2025. $1-2Bn peak target, first non-Ingrezza blockbuster for NBIX.

_notes: Neuroscience/endocrinology biotech. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
